m: गो—˚अश्वीय n. N. of a Sāman.
गो—अश्व n. sg. cattle and horses, ChUp. vii, 24, 2
गो—अश्व m. pl. id., ŚBr. xiv, 9, 1, 10 (cf. गवाश्व.)
गो—अग्र (गो-), mf(आ)n. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 122, Kāś.) headed by cows, having cows or milk as the chief or most excellent part, RV.
गो—अजन mfn. serving to drive cattle (a stick, goad), vii, 33, 6.
गो—अपश (गो-), accord. to some, ‘(a goad) having a cow-horn as its point’, RV. vi, 53, 9
गो—अर्घ mfn. of the value of a cow, TS. vi, 1, 10, 1 (also अ-ग्˚ neg.)
गो—अर्णस् (गो-), mfn. (flowing with i.e.) abounding in cattle, RV. i, 112, 18; x, 38, 2 and 76, 3
abounding in stars or rays, ii, 34, 12.
